Authentication and identity plane. Includes login, OAuth flows, SSO, token issuance, and session management. High-value target for account takeover and auth bypass vulnerabilities.

Core Box API surface. Includes endpoints for files, folders, users, collaborations, shared links, search, metadata, governance, Shield, events, and AI-related functionality. Primary surface for authorization and data access vulnerabilities.
File upload pipeline. Includes file ingestion, processing, and storage entry points. Relevant for malware bypass, file parsing, and content validation vulnerabilities.
File download and content delivery network. Includes signed URLs and file access mechanisms. Relevant for data exposure, token leakage, and access control issues.
